title: Kestrel and the Room
author: R. M. Montrose
blurb: Wendell Voss, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
